question: Does the WP36 removal of chain rescue (sampler::DEFAULT_CHAIN_RESCUE = None; v6 ran with ChainRescueConfig::restart_from_best()) explain the posteriordb v6 -> v7 drop in oWALNUTS min-bulk-ESS per gradient (0.848 -> 0.708x CmdStan over the fixed 16)?
commit_note: main c8b4bb2d; its src/ differs from f097391c (the v7 commit) only in documentation and in diagnostics::ChainWarning reporting nonfinite-position rejections (WP59); the sampler, kernel and defaults are the same, so draws at c8b4bb2d equal draws at f097391c. The worktree was fast-forwarded to c8b4bb2d and the driver checks src/, integrations/, tests/ and Cargo.toml against it.

arms.rescue_off: Sampler::new() with only warmup 1000, draws 1000, chains 4, seed, threads 4 and Limits::new().admit_worst_case(); Adaptation::default() (no chain rescue, the current default); starts Init::default() = best_of(16)
arms.rescue_on: identical, plus .adaptation(Adaptation::Custom(WarmupConfig::new(0.8).with_warmup_exhaustion_rule(DEFAULT_WARMUP_EXHAUSTION).with_metric_regularization(DEFAULT_METRIC_REGULARIZATION).with_chain_rescue(ChainRescueConfig::restart_from_best()))): exactly what Adaptation::default() built under the WP33 rescue default used by v6, and how WP36's `current` arm was built

not_v6: rescue_on is current defaults plus rescue, not v6: v6 also used Init::uniform() starts (WP52 changed that; WP60 found best_of_16 / uniform = 1.061 on six models) and v6's seeds.
model_selection: accel_gp, one_comp and hmm_drive_0 (named), plus the two fixed-16 models with the largest v6 -> v7 oWALNUTS min-bulk-ESS/gradient drop other than those, computed from STUDIES/posteriordb_bench_v7/artifacts/summary.json versus_v6 (v7/v6 seed-median ratio): eight_schools_centered 0.594 and nes2000 0.908 (the named three are 0.423, 0.688, 0.710).
seeds_verified_unused: git grep -w over every tracked file of the worktree at c8b4bb2d found none of 610601-610605
run_order: models in listed order; within a model seeds ascending; within a seed rescue_off then rescue_on; strictly sequential
parameter_set: posteriordb reference-draw columns; ArviZ 0.23.4; reference z reported

statistic.cell: min over reference parameters of bulk ESS / gradients_total (start search, warmup, sampling)
statistic.model_ratio: geomean over the paired seeds of rescue_on / rescue_off
statistic.primary: geomean of the five model ratios; also the count of models above and below 1.0
statistic.telemetry: every ChainRescueUpdate that is not `kept` (restarts with criterion, source, transition, step before/after), restart counts per cell, per-chain end-of-warmup step, warmup gradients, per-chain ESS, chain warnings, max |z|

hypotheses.H1: rescue removal explains the drop: rescue_on / rescue_off paired geomean >= 1.15
hypotheses.H0: it does not (fresh seeds do): paired geomean < 1.05

decision_rule: Attribution only. No default flip and no recommendation to restore rescue follows from any outcome: WP36 rejected restart_from_best as the default for mode-hiding reasons (the density rule fires on merely late chains and on every fresh-seed second-mode hmm_drive_0 draw, and the frozen origin classifier could not show the moved chains were nuisance rather than genuine modes). A failed cell is a result; its seed is unpaired for that model.
rules: No reruns, no tuning after results; walls contended and not evidence.
